# example_item (Resource)

An item in the store. Renaming an item updates it in place; the identifier stays the same for the life of the resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "example_item" "web_frontend" {
  name        = "web-frontend"
  description = "Public entry point for the web tier"
  tags        = ["edge", "prod"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name for the item. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores; must start with a letter.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form summary of the item.
- `tags` (Set of String) Labels attached to the item. Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier assigned by the store when the item is created.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Items are imported by the identifier the store assigned them, which is the
# value of the item's `id` attribute in the store file.
terraform import example_item.web_frontend itm-dferclnkohufiylwcwoa4st662
```
